description: R3 (ChatGPT GPT-6) per-record audit response. One JSON object per line (JSONL), one per reviewed item, same order as the batch, each sample_id exactly once. R3 assigns audit labels only; it never confers VERIFIED, approves a category, or authorizes training. Model agreement is diagnostic, not independent ground truth.

sample_id.description: stable record id, echoed from the batch (e.g. PF1-0001)

better_category.description: set only when the payload is a real payload of a different category

rationale.description: one concise, evidence-based sentence; no line breaks

unevaluated_response.description: Used instead of a label_response when an item could not be evaluated. NEVER a substitute for a label; the coordinator logs it and counts it against coverage. No label is fabricated.

reason.description: why the item could not be evaluated (e.g. refusal, truncation, tool failure)

coordinator_only_execution_metadata.description: Recorded by the coordinator AFTER R3 runs; never prepopulated, never invented. Lives outside reviewer materials.
coordinator_only_execution_metadata.designation_mismatch_rule: If the exposed model designation is not the approved ChatGPT GPT-6, STOP and flag to the owner BEFORE evaluation; do not silently substitute a reviewer.
